summary.text: Rob Kreibich is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 28 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Robin Lillesve.
His career includes work as a newscaster, in health care marketing, and as president and CEO of the New Richmond Area Chamber of Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Rob Kreibich defeated Danielle Johnson in the November 5, 2024 general election for Assembly District 28.

For 2025-2026 he chairs the Commerce Committee and is vice-chair of the Financial Institutions Committee, and he also sits on the Colleges and Universities, Housing and Real Estate, and Workforce Development committees.
